messages:
Asha Gupta: Heads-up 10: we just finished the FlowAI meeting. They doubled down on cost alerts + billing exports. They said per-route drilldown is "nice to have" but budget guardrails + anomaly detection are must-haves.
Liam O'Connor: Interesting. That changes priorities. If customers want real-time budget guards, we need both cheap metrics and a fast anomaly detector. Full per-route attribution can be asynchronous.
Rae Morgan: From infra: realtime ~= stream processing (kafka -> lightweight aggregator -> alerting). We can do threshold-based alerts quickly; ML anomaly detection will need offline features.
Priya Desai: UX: budget guardrails must be actionable: set threshold (% over baseline), choose notification channels (email, webhook, console toast), and include suggested mitigation (throttle routes, switch to cheaper model variant).
Asha Gupta: Proposed scope for MVP (rollup-first, realtime alerts):
- Billing export: hourly rollups per customer + optional route tag
- Budget guard: user-defined monthly/weekly budget + % over baseline alerts (console + webhook)
- Anomaly detector: simple EWMA-based spike detector on hourly cost (configurable sensitivity)
- Billing CSV export: hourly rollup for 30d
- TODO: historical per-route drilldown (Q2)
Liam O'Connor: Implementation notes: we add a route_tag header at ingress (opt-in). Legacy clients without tagging fall into "unattributed" bucket. In rollups we keep customer_id, route (nullable), model_variant.
Rae Morgan: We should cap the retention for raw request logs to 7d to control cost and keep rollups longer. Also propose a cheap sidecar sampler that emits lightweight counters instead of full traces for cost telemetry.
Priya Desai: UI flow: Budget create -> baseline estimation (auto) -> alert channels -> recommended mitigations (dropdown). Show a sample alert preview.
Asha Gupta: Acceptance criteria draft (observability-bot inserted):
- Hourly billing rollup exported to S3/BigQuery with columns [timestamp, customer_id, route, model_variant, token_count, cost_usd] for 30d
- Budget guard: users can set budget and sensitivity; console shows current burn vs budget and triggers webhook/email when exceeded
- Anomaly detector: EWMA spike alerts with tuning knobs; alerts include last 24h sparkline and top contributing routes (if tagged)
- UI: Create budget modal + preview alert + CSV export ability
- Safety: If route tagging fails, requests attributed to "unattributed" and budget still enforced at customer level
- Performance: alert evaluation latency < 2m for hourly data
Asha Gupta: Rough estimates: 2 engineers for 3 sprints to ship rollup + budget UI + threshold alerts. Add ML engineer later for advanced anomaly models.
Liam O'Connor: Dependencies: tagging SDK change, rollup pipeline, minimal storage (hourly) + alerting infra (existing). Also decide whether budget enforcement (throttling) is part of MVP or follow-up.
Rae Morgan: We should NOT implement automatic throttles in v1. That's a security/risk area. Provide recommended actions and an operator API to do soft-throttles manually.
Priya Desai: I'll mock the budget modal and alert cards. Can post tomorrow morning. :sparkles: Rae, can you share sample retention numbers so I can design the table?
Rae Morgan: Will post retention/size calc by EOD. Quick note: EWMA detector false-positive rate depends on sensitivity; default to conservative.
observability-bot: Actions created: [#B1] Ingress tag opt-in PR (Liam) due 1725086400; [#B2] Rollup pipeline + S3 export (Rae) due 1725172800; [#B3] Budget UI mocks (Priya) due 1725014000; [#B4] Alert evaluation infra (Rae) due 1725172800; [#B5] Customer review demo (Asha) due 1725259200
Asha Gupta: OK. Decision: ship rollups + threshold budgets + EWMA alerts in v1. Per-route historical drilldown and ML detectors targeted for Q2. Anyone object?
Liam O'Connor: No objections. We should add a flag for customers who want immediate route-level export (beta).
Rae Morgan: No objections. Will build pipeline to support route nullable field.
Priya Desai: No objections. I'll prepare mocks and include a small FAQ about attribution gaps.
Asha Gupta: Thanks all. I'll create the planning card and set up a 30m kickoff tomorrow 9:30am. :calendar:
